hello.text: Ah, a traveller! Welcome to Mossbrook. Forgive an old woman her worries.

problem.text: Thieves took my amulet last night, the stone that keeps our wells sweet. They fled into the old cellar under the chapel ruins, across the river.

danger.text: It is. Rats and worse live down there. Bram the smith could arm you, and Wren has remedies.

accept.text: Bless you. The trapdoor is in the ruins east of the bridge. Do take care.

waiting.text: Any sign of my amulet? The trapdoor is in the chapel ruins, east across the bridge.

reward.text: Take these coins, and know that Mossbrook will not forget you.

thanks_again.text: Thanks to you, the wells run sweet again.

hello.text: Mind the seedlings! Oh, hello. I'm Wren. I make remedies, when I have glowcaps.

explain.text: Glowing mushrooms. They only grow in the dark, like in the old cellar. Bring me three and I'll make it worth your while.

thanks.text: Wonderful! Watch out for the slimes; they love glowcaps too.

waiting.text: Found any glowcaps yet? I need three.

reward.text: Here: two potions, and my late husband's leather vest. It will serve you better than it serves the moths.

done.text: The remedies are coming along nicely, thanks to you.

first.text: You've the look of someone heading into trouble. Here, take this. I've no use for a spare.

tip.text: Open your bag to put it in your hand. Bare fists won't do much against what's in that cellar.

shop.text: Need anything? A round shield's fifteen coins.

sold.text: Good oak, that. It'll turn a rat's tooth.

hello.text: Rats! Rats from that cursed cellar, eating my grain.

thanks.text: Three of them should teach the rest a lesson.

waiting.text: I still hear them scratching about at night.

return.text: No more scratching! Here, for your trouble.

done.text: Best harvest in years, if the weather holds.

hello.text: Did you know there's a cellar under the old chapel? The grown-ups say it's haunted.

haunted.text: Skeletons! Way down deep. Mum says if you get hurt, eat something. Bread helps!

after.text: You're the hero! Can I see the amulet? ...You gave it back? Aww.

first.text: Oh! A visitor. Sit, sit. Here, take some bread. You look half-starved.

rats.text: Tom's been on about those rats for weeks. Squash a few and he'll stop his moaning.

rats_done.text: Not a squeak since you dealt with those rats. Bless you, dear.

weather.text: My knees say rain's coming. They're never wrong, my knees.

purr.text: Whiskers purrs and winds around your ankles.
